title: [Research note] Exact selected complex coarse depth and conditional stock bill
body:
The selected **complex m=73/max-rank-48** profile has exact worst-path thresholds `b_1=73`, `b_(d+1)=73*ceil(b_d/48)` under its inherited floor-child and terminal contracts. The written proof establishes the sharp asymptotic depth rate and an exact **43/26** allowance. This is a research note / scoped mathematical audit, with **no new κ or supplier adoption**.

The source-bound finite stock has 2,642 bits. Replacing only its modeled depth component gives a **conditional** row comparison `16469 -> 15555` (914 less). The per-level physical divisor and other row-ledger terms still need admission; this number is not inserted into the selected receipt. All helpers, private centres, coefficient work, precision reserves and recursive children remain charged.

The ordinary bootstrap is separately **BIT m=64/max-rank-42**. Concurrent Adam Gall PR2084 and PR2087 prompted an explicit producer-boundary check, independently corroborated against the frozen PR589 record. This m=73 result does not supply their ordinary producer's stock coefficient. The selected stage-2 exponent is used only for a parameter comparison. The predecessor two-level halving guard is credited, not claimed as new.

Verification on CPython 3.12.13, standard library only:

- All 2,080 block decisions for `1<=p<=64, 1<=q<=p`: 1,227 pass, with 43/26 the minimum **within that domain**.
- Forward recursion, inverse thresholds and an all-child dynamic program agree on 103,139 widths, including every width 0..100,000 and power/threshold boundaries.
- Twelve semantic/source controls reject; eight focused tests pass normally and with `-O`; direct optimized replay, package metadata, source baseline and staged diff checks pass.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-coarse-depth-stock
```

Expected: `PASS_SELECTED_COARSE_DEPTH_STOCK block=43/26 widths=103139 conditional_row=16469->15555 controls=12 no_new_kappa`, followed by passing normal/optimized tests and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.
